name: Grok Connectors
desc: Deep links from Grok into the apps you already use every day.
desc_zh: 把 Grok 深度接入你已在用的邮件、日历、云盘与表格应用。
solves: Answers stop at the boundary of the chat window; connectors let Grok read and update the actual tools your work lives in.
solves_zh: 回答总停在聊天窗口边界；连接器让 Grok 能读写你真正干活的那批工具。
best_for: You want Grok to summarize this morning's email and update a slide deck without copying anything across.
best_for_zh: 想让 Grok 总结今早邮件并更新一份幻灯片，又不想来回复制内容时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — x.ai/news directory）。 Missing from the ledger. Released 2026-05-06, one day before the discovery window opens, so it qualifies as a missing entry rather than a window hit. The homepage grok.com/connectors returns 403 to curl (bot guard); the URL is linked from the official announcement.
